g.text: Infection crosses a contact whenever one side was
A is infected. Four contacts happen one at a time:
A-B, B-C, C-D, D-E. If they happen in the order D-E, C-D,
B-C, A-B, how many people other than A can get infected?
Four contacts stacked in one undated column ("?"). No day axis.
Infection crosses a contact whenever one side was
QA step 2 (slider to 2, then Day 4). Contacts climb up-right;
A meets B last, on day 4. Reached 1 of 4.
Infection crosses a contact whenever one side was
Staircase down-right: one hop per day. Reached 4 of 4.
4. QA end: Overlap, first E, day 4
Infection crosses a contact whenever one side was
Not quite. In the order E→A, A met B last, so
only B was reached. In the order A→E all four were.
With Overlap, all four were reached starting from E too.
(reveal text: learning designer; quotes only reached states)
Path: slider (day 2) · Day 4 · A→E · E→A · Overlap · A (disabled, skipped) · E.
Milestone 3 (two-way) on the last press. Stage words: 24.
